notes.title: Last Final Test Build
notes.notes:
Hello dear ghost,

in this new Build, it is finally possible to play also on macOS! We've set the architecure to intel 64-bit.
 
At the following list you can see everything that has changed since February 2025:
1. macOS Build Support for intel 64-bits.
2. you can now hear ambient music tracks by toggeling the toggle on in the setting in the following worlds: The Christmas Secret, the Cemetery Silence, the Desert Trap, Pirate Islands and in the Knight Parcour.
3. the fullscreen mode change has been disabled.
4. new updated quality settings.
5. added simple anti cheat system for multiplayer rounds. If you are cheating it's possible to be banned for 48 hours.
6. new setting for multiplayer parties: the masterclient can now set a toggle to allowing other clients to show the current party id.
7. in every scenery we have updated the post processing filters.
8. the multiplayer mode is now set on final test phase.
9. season 2 is starting - so claim your rewards!

Fixed buggs:
1. the not reseting of the played rounds in the season hunt mode has been updated to reseting every single day once.
2. in multiplayer rounds it's not possible anymore to be able to jump while you're in the air.
3. you can now finally equip your hats again!
4. fixed the issue with random windows setting on true at the beginning in the menu.
5. fixed the button animations for the normals and the mode selections.

Thanks for testing "The Land of Magic Playtest"! You're welcome! Please let us know if you have any further questions or problems!

 - The Land of Magic Team 👻
